notes: Corrected: 'Now' is aligned to the waw of וְהִנֵּה rather than marked added with the waw left unrepresented. A waw stands in the verse, 'now' is one of the connectives rule 14 records for it, and the ASV has fronted it over the preposed temporal clause, which rules 25 and 51 allow; rule 14's added clause governs only a clause with no conjunction morpheme in it at all.
The waw's clause keeps 'behold' on הִנֵּה, so nothing else in the sentence competes for the connective.
'were' stays on the fronted preposition as the clause's predicate under rule 49; the alternative of putting it on 'trees' is named in that unit's note.
